import pytest
from node import Node

if pytest.use_correct:
    from correct_python_programs.breadth_first_search import breadth_first_search
else:
    from python_programs.breadth_first_search import breadth_first_search


def test_attack_1():
    """start is goal with no successors must be reachable."""
    a = Node("A")
    a.successors = []
    assert breadth_first_search(a, a) is True


def test_attack_2():
    """direct edge start -> goal must be reachable."""
    goal = Node("GOAL")
    goal.successors = []
    start = Node("START")
    start.successors = [goal]
    assert breadth_first_search(start, goal) is True


def test_attack_3():
    """multi-hop chain that does not contain goal must return False, not raise."""
    c = Node("C")
    c.successors = []
    b = Node("B")
    b.successors = [c]
    start = Node("START")
    start.successors = [b]
    goal = Node("GOAL")
    goal.successors = []
    assert breadth_first_search(start, goal) is False


def test_attack_4():
    """cycle with no path to goal must return False, not hang or raise."""
    a = Node("A")
    b = Node("B")
    a.successors = [b]
    b.successors = [a]
    goal = Node("GOAL")
    goal.successors = []
    assert breadth_first_search(a, goal) is False


def test_attack_5():
    """dead-end branch popped first must not cause premature False."""
    goal = Node("GOAL")
    goal.successors = []
    dead = Node("DEAD")
    dead.successors = []
    mid = Node("MID")
    mid.successors = [goal]
    start = Node("START")
    # dead first in queue order
    start.successors = [dead, mid]
    assert breadth_first_search(start, goal) is True


def test_attack_6():
    """distinct objects with same value must not match (identity, not equality)."""
    inner = Node("X")
    inner.successors = []
    start = Node("START")
    start.successors = [inner]
    goal = Node("X")
    goal.successors = []
    # inner and goal have same name but are different objects, unconnected
    assert inner is not goal
    assert breadth_first_search(start, goal) is False


def test_attack_7():
    """diamond with self-loop on intermediate must still find goal."""
    goal = Node("GOAL")
    goal.successors = []
    d = Node("D")
    d.successors = []  # filled below to include self-loop + goal
    b = Node("B")
    b.successors = [d]
    c = Node("C")
    c.successors = [d]
    start = Node("START")
    start.successors = [b, c]
    d.successors = [d, goal]
    assert breadth_first_search(start, goal) is True


def test_attack_8():
    """self-loop only, goal unreachable, must return False without hanging."""
    start = Node("START")
    start.successors = [start]
    goal = Node("GOAL")
    goal.successors = []
    assert breadth_first_search(start, goal) is False
